question: How long does the Samsung Galaxy S10 last between charges in everyday use?
contexts: Battery Drains fast and charging cable sub-par. So this phone is great. It's a big upgrade from my last android. I've only had it for 5 days and so far I love it, except that the battery drains very fast. I don't keep a lot of apps on my phone. It is used only for texting, calls, and a little online shopping, browsing, social media. But otherwise, doesn't seem like the device should only last one day before needing to charge again. My last phone could go longer between charges and that was a much older phone! Plus, the charger that was sent with this phone is not a Samsung charger. Instead it says Sharkk on it- never heard of this brand. Each time I plug the phone into the charger, a message pops up on phone that says to check the connection between the phone and charger.

Battery messed up in less the 6 months!!. Its been less then 6 months and my battery is already messed up. It won't hold charge, I don't leave it on the charger all night or while I sleep. 100% battery lasts me 2 hour at most. Phone even dies when it isn't in use. And the amount they're charging me for a battery replacement is crazy smh never again. Save your money and go to a big corp company where you can get insurance
I'm disappointed that I have to put it on charge every 8-9 hours. My last phone prior to this one lasted a few days before having to charge it again.

Disappointed with battery. The battery on this phone absolutely su.ks. It doesn't last all day. It lasts about 6 hours. I had read the same comment from other reviewers. I needed a new phone because the battery on my old one was only lasting a couple of hours. Very disappointed with the battery charge. The real good thing is the camera is outstanding. I have not been able to check out all the camera features, but the pictures I've taken so far are much superior to any other phone camera I've used.

has charging problems.. Everything seems fine but I leave it charging all night and another day it only delays 3 hours and it no longer has a charge I have to charge it connected because otherwise it turns off, I had to buy another charger because the one it brings does not work.

Battery is so slow to charge ! Cable slips out. The battery takes 8-10 hours to charge with cable and it often slips "out" of the charging port. I tried purchasing a new cable with lightning charging capabilities, and it's slightly faster, about 6 hours to charge and i purchased a wireless qi charger that takes about 8 hours to charge from 20% to 100 I really like this phone, its a beautiful color and works perfectly other then the battery drains so fast, and it just won't charge well :c
Battery doesn't last. The phone did arrive in good physical condition but the battery dies quickly. A fully charged battery lasts me 3 hours maximum.

Moisture warning when charging. Phone has lasted 8 months only. Now there is a moisture message preventing the phone from being charged even though there is no moisture. I have tried cleaning and all the tricks but comes back. I even had the charging entry point fixed but the problem persisted so there is something over heating on malfunctioning in the phone. Disappointed but will not buy a phone like this again even thought the price is enticing.

Battery drains fast with normal use. Battery drains way faster than my last phone.last the whole day on average but if you listen to music or play videos you will be charging by 5 o'clock.phone is fast.screen is vivid.takes amazing photos.just battery life and it's feels dainty.i bought a heavy duty case for it and I like it alot more

Phone didn't last 10 months. The phone didn't make it to 10-months before it started getting extremely hot, takes forever to charge and drains the batter faster than it charges. My last refurbished phone lasted 4 years. I'm highly disappointed.
answer:
One reviewer reported that the Galaxy S10 lasts about one day before needing to charge again with only texting, calls, and light browsing. [ce4618a4bfaf_0]
Another reviewer said they have to put the phone on charge every 8-9 hours. [76db1ee6a786_1]
A different reviewer reported the battery lasts about 6 hours and does not last all day. [8e51bc830f71_0]
One reviewer said a fully charged battery lasts them 3 hours maximum. [d24d3d742e77_0]
Another reviewer said the phone lasts the whole day on average but requires charging by 5 o'clock when listening to music or playing videos. [1acf5874a5be_0]
One reviewer reported that 100% battery lasts them 2 hours at most after less than 6 months of use. [79dfc9eeb023_0]
